questions.question: Seven people A, B, C, D, E, F and G are sitting around a circular table, facing the centre (but not necessarily in the same order). B is sitting third to the right of D. G is sitting second to the left of A. E is sitting to the immediate right of G. Only three people are sitting between E and C when counted from the left of E. C is not an immediate neighbour of A. The position of how many persons will remain unchanged except A if all the persons are arranged in the English alphabetical order in anti-clockwise direction, starting from A and keeping the position of A unchanged?

questions.solution:
Each letter moves +6 forward in the alphabet.

Solution
NQRP → TWXV
FHIG → LNOM

Similarly,
LOPN → RUVT

Answer
(b) RUVT

questions.question: When the signs + and ÷ as well as the numbers 5 and 10 are interchanged, which option will be the correct one?
questions.questionHtml: When the signs + and ÷ as well as the numbers 5 and 10 are interchanged, which option will be the correct one?
questions.solution:
Interchange + with ÷ and 5 with 10, then check which equation becomes correct.

Solution
Option (b): 5 + 10 ÷ 2 = 4

After interchange:
10 ÷ 5 + 2 = 4
2 + 2 = 4

Answer
(b) 5 + 10 ÷ 2 = 4

questions.questionHtml:
Select the number from among the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

457, 488, 525, 566, 609, ?
questions.solution:
Difference is increasing by +6, +4, +2 pattern alternately.

Now differences are:
31, 37, 41, 43

These are consecutive prime numbers:
31, 37, 41, 43, 47

So, next number = 609 + 47 = 656

Answer: (a) 656

questions.question: If 1 January 2020 was a Wednesday, then what day of the week was it on 1 January 2021?
questions.questionHtml: If 1 January 2020 was a Wednesday, then what day of the week was it on 1 January 2021?
questions.solution:
Logic:
2020 was a leap year, so it had 366 days.
366 ÷ 7 leaves 2 odd days.

Answer: (d) Friday
